name: FPD C-Arm
shortDescription: High-resolution flat panel detector C-arm for precise intraoperative imaging in surgical suites.
overview: The EduSoft FPD C-Arm delivers exceptional intraoperative imaging quality with its advanced flat panel detector technology. Designed for demanding surgical environments, it offers real-time fluoroscopy with minimal X-ray dose, supporting orthopedic, vascular, and trauma procedures.
keyFeatures: Large 30 cm × 30 cm flat panel detector for wide field of view
High frame rate fluoroscopy up to 30 fps
Motorized C-arm for precise angulation control
Automatic Brightness Control (ABC) for consistent image quality
DICOM 3.0 compliant with PACS integration
Compact footprint for easy maneuverability in the OR
Low dose pulsed fluoroscopy mode
clinicalUseCases: Orthopedic surgery: fracture reduction, nail/screw placement verification
Vascular interventions: angiography and stent placement
Trauma surgery: real-time guidance for complex fixations
Urology: ureteroscopy and stone fragmentation guidance

name: RVG Sensor
shortDescription: Digital intraoral RVG sensor delivering instant, high-resolution dental radiographs with significantly reduced patient dose.
overview: The EduSoft RVG (RadioVisioGraphy) Sensor enables immediate digital intraoral imaging with superior image quality. Its thin profile and flexible design ensure patient comfort while delivering the diagnostic detail that dentists and endodontists require.
keyFeatures: Ultra-thin 5 mm sensor thickness for patient comfort
Resolution up to 20 lp/mm for precise diagnosis
Immediate image preview in < 2 seconds
Up to 70% dose reduction vs. conventional film
Compatible with major dental software via TWAIN bridge
Durable construction with autoclavable positioning rings
Available in Size 1 (pediatric) and Size 2 (adult)
clinicalUseCases: Endodontic treatment planning and working length determination
Implant placement planning and post-operative verification

name: X-Ray Printer
shortDescription: High-throughput medical dry laser printer producing diagnostic-quality radiograph prints for clinical and archival use.
overview: The EduSoft X-Ray Printer is a professional dry-process medical imaging printer engineered for high-volume radiology departments. DICOM-compliant and compatible with all major imaging modalities, it delivers consistent, archival-grade diagnostic prints.
keyFeatures: Dry laser technology — no chemicals, no darkroom required
Print resolution up to 508 dpi
DICOM 3.0 compliant for seamless modality integration
Throughput up to 100 sheets/hour
Multiple film format support: 14×17", 11×14", 10×12", 8×10"
Network-enabled for multi-workstation access
Calibrated output with built-in densitometer
clinicalUseCases: Radiology department hardcopy output for diagnostic review
Orthopedic film production for surgical planning

name: X-Ray Film
shortDescription: Premium dry and wet X-ray film media for diagnostic imaging, compatible with all major X-ray printers and processors.
overview: EduSoft X-Ray Film provides exceptional image clarity and archival stability for diagnostic radiology. Available in dry (laser) and wet (processor-compatible) variants, the film is optimized for superior contrast and grey-scale reproduction.
keyFeatures: Available in dry laser and wet process variants
Wide latitude for consistent exposure results
High Dmax for excellent contrast in dense tissue areas
10-year archival stability under standard storage conditions
Available in all standard radiology formats
Blue and clear base options available

specifications.Variants: Dry Laser, Blue-base wet, Clear-base wet

name: PACS/RIS
shortDescription: Integrated Picture Archiving & Communication System with Radiology Information System for enterprise-wide imaging workflow management.
overview: EduSoft PACS/RIS is a comprehensive enterprise imaging solution that manages the complete radiology workflow — from patient scheduling and order management through image acquisition, interpretation, reporting, and archival. DICOM and HL7 compliant, it integrates seamlessly with hospital HIS systems.
keyFeatures: Full DICOM 3.0 and HL7 v2.x compliance
Web-based viewer accessible from any device
Advanced hanging protocols for rapid read workflow
Integrated AI triage and priority flagging
Long-term archival with redundant storage options
Role-based access control and full audit trail
RIS modules: scheduling, worklist, report dictation, billing

specifications.Supported Modalities: All DICOM modalities (CT, MRI, CR, DR, US, NM, XA)
specifications.Security: AES-256 encryption, RBAC, full audit logs

clinicalUseCases: Radiology department workflow management and reporting
Emergency radiology triage with AI priority scoring
Teaching hospital case library and education

name: Image Acquisition Software
shortDescription: Intelligent image acquisition workstation software with auto-exposure optimization and seamless DICOM send to PACS.
overview: EduSoft Image Acquisition Software streamlines the DR/CR acquisition workflow, providing technologists with an intuitive interface for patient registration, exposure management, image processing, and DICOM routing. Built for high-throughput radiology environments.
keyFeatures: DICOM Modality Worklist (MWL) integration
Automated image enhancement and noise reduction
One-click DICOM send to PACS
Touchscreen-optimized interface for fast workflow
Multi-detector support (CR, DR, fluoroscopy)
Dose tracking and reporting (DRL comparison)
Body region templates with automatic collimation guidance
clinicalUseCases: Digital radiography acquisition in radiology departments
Pediatric radiology with age-based dose optimization

name: TB Screening AI
shortDescription: AI-powered chest X-ray analysis tool for automated tuberculosis screening, triage, and preliminary reporting support.
overview: EduSoft TB Screening AI leverages deep learning algorithms trained on large clinical datasets to analyze chest X-rays for TB-related findings. Designed to support — not replace — radiologists in high-volume screening programs, it helps prioritize worklists and extend the reach of specialist expertise to underserved regions.
keyFeatures: Automated analysis of chest PA radiographs for TB-associated findings
Confidence scoring and visual heatmap overlay
DICOM-integrated: reads directly from PACS worklist
Results in < 30 seconds per image
Supports batch processing for high-volume screening campaigns
API integration for third-party RIS/PACS systems
Audit trail compliant with medical device software regulations

specifications.Regulatory: CE marked (Class IIa Medical Device Software)

clinicalUseCases: National TB screening programs in high-burden regions
Rural and remote health outreach programs
Point-of-care screening in primary health centres

shortDescription: Comprehensive range of lead-lined radiation protection apparel and shielding for patients, staff, and facilities.
overview: EduSoft Radiation Protection products are designed to the highest safety standards, meeting IEC 61331 and NCRP guidelines. Our range covers protective aprons, thyroid shields, eye protection, gonadal shields, and custom lead-lined architectural shielding.

Lightweight lead-composite material for staff comfort
Available in vest-and-skirt or wrap-around configurations
Pediatric sizes available
Machine-washable outer covers
5-year material warranty

CR cassettes in all standard sizes
